sloka: महान्तम् दारुणम् भीमम् कबंधम् भुज संवृतम् ।कबंधम् इव संस्थानत् अति घोर प्रदशनम् ॥३-६९-३४॥
transliteration: mahāntam dāruṇam bhīmam kabaṁdham bhuja saṁvṛtam ।kabaṁdham iva saṁsthānat ati ghora pradaśanam ॥3-69-34॥

translations.english: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.
